check_date.description: Check one date and get four plain answers: is it a public holiday, are the schools out, is it a weekend, is it a working day. Use it to gate a workflow on whether an office is open, or to hold a send that would land on a day off. It defaults to today, so 'is today a holiday' needs nothing but the country. Only Public holidays count as a day off unless you say otherwise, and anything else marked on the date is reported separately rather than silently dropped.

list_school_holidays_by_date.description: Ask one date of every country at once and get back the ones whose schools are closed that day. School holidays are staggered across Europe, so this is how to see, in one step, which offices will be thin on the ground in a given week. Defaults to today, and can be narrowed to the countries you operate in.

description: Look up public holidays and school holidays for 36 countries from a workflow. List a country's public holidays for a year or a date range, get the next one coming up, check whether a date, or today, is a holiday, and count the working days between two dates with weekends and holidays taken out. School holidays are the unusual part: term breaks come back as spans of days, down to the state, canton or school zone that keeps them, so a workflow can plan around the weeks parents are away. One step also answers a date across every country at once, for a team spread over several. Names come back in any of 30 languages. Every action reads: nothing here changes anything. No account or API key required.
